recognize_zh: 高倍下腺體間充滿中型、核形不規則且略有摺痕的細胞，細胞質淡染至微嗜酸性，核染色質中等偏深、核仁不明顯；腺體完整、未見壞死或血管破壞，是NK細胞腸病的細胞學特徵，但須以免疫染色與EBER排除NK/T細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated to indented nuclei
Moderately dense chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale to faintly eosinophilic cytoplasm (cytoplasmic granules not resolved on H&E)
Infiltrate fills the lamina propria between intact glands without evident gland destruction
No necrosis or angiodestruction; scattered small capillaries with red cells
describe_en: High-power examination of gastrointestinal mucosa shows the lamina propria filled by medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated nuclei, moderately dense chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm. The infiltrate surrounds intact glands without significant epitheliotropism, necrosis or angiodestructive features. Mitotic activity is not prominent in this field. The cytologic atypia raises concern for NK/T-cell lymphoma, but in the context of an NK-cell phenotype (CD56+, cytoplasmic CD3+, CD5-), EBER negativity and a superficial non-destructive pattern, the findings are compatible with NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is EBER-positive with angiocentric destruction and coagulative necrosis, whereas NK-cell enteropathy is EBER-negative and non-destructive.
MEITL cells invade crypt epithelium extensively and show clonal TCR rearrangement with surface CD3/CD8 expression.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5 rather than NK-cell markers.
